mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, email, phone, avatar_url, signature, gender, birthday, cover_url, steam_id, steam_persona_name, steam_avatar_url, steam_playtime_minutes, steam_playtime_updated_at, steam_achievements_json, steam_achievements_total, steam_achievements_count, steam_achievements_updated_at, steam_level, role, status, last_login_time, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE steam_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 AND (steam_playtime_updated_at IS NULL OR steam_playtime_updated_at <= #{updatedBefore}) ORDER BY steam_playtime_updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, username, nickname, email, phone, avatar_url, signature, gender, birthday, cover_url, steam_id, steam_persona_name, steam_avatar_url, steam_playtime_minutes, steam_playtime_updated_at, steam_achievements_json, steam_achievements_total, steam_achievements_count, steam_achievements_updated_at, steam_level, role, status, last_login_time, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE steam_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 AND steam_playtime_minutes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY steam_playtime_minutes DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 12000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg0, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 12000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 24000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg1, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 24000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 36000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg2, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 36000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 48000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg3, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 48000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg4, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 60000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 72000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg5, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 72000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 84000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg6, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 84000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 96000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg7, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 96000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 108000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg8, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 108000 AND COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) < 120000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg9, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(steam_playtime_minutes, 0) >= 120000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seg10 FROM users WHERE steam_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 1
SELECT steam_achievements_json FROM users WHERE steam_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 AND steam_achievements_json IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(steam_achievements_json) != ''
